title: Local acceptance conflicts with authoritative rejection
given: A local model accepts a candidate under the predicates encoded so far.
The pinned authoritative surface rejects that candidate.
No downstream-predicate discovery receipt exists.

title: Evidence covers one named decision frontier
given: Provenance accounts for every input-dependent decision through frontier P.
Any surrogate receipt covers every comparison point through P.
The authoritative path beyond P has not been exercised.

title: Pinned authoritative path is fully accounted
given: The pinned authoritative path was exercised from controlled input to terminal response.
Every evidence-reachable input-dependent decision is accounted for.
No downstream decision or contradiction remains unresolved.

title: Affordable downstream discovery precedes large search
given: A downstream decision discovery costs four budget units.
A proposed solver run costs six units.
Ten budget units remain.
The downstream decision remains pending.

title: Repaired surrogate has not been re-matched
given: A surrogate diverged from the original at comparison Q.
The surrogate was repaired and now refutes a candidate after Q.
No new original-versus-surrogate match was observed at or beyond Q.

title: Affordable candidate members remain untried
given: A candidate-set obligation has three untried members.
Each authoritative submission costs one unit.
Five budget units remain.

title: Contradiction audit exceeds remaining budget
given: A useful local fact is proven.
An authoritative contradiction remains unresolved.
The cheapest audit costs three units and two units remain.
The authoritative boundary is available.

title: Close is requested while a contradiction remains
given: A local primitive exists.
An authoritative contradiction remains unresolved.
The proposed next action is close.

title: Repeated parameter variation adds no decision information
given: Two completed runs share evidence source, representation, and method.
Only timeout, worker count, encoding, or engine library changed.
No hypothesis, candidate, capability, or acceptance-ledger state changed.

title: Independent evidence changes a strategy prerequisite
given: An observation outside the strategy's own interventions changes its prerequisite.
The evidence provenance is recorded.

title: A single-preimage receipt proves uniqueness
given: A receipt proves the relation has exactly one preimage in the declared domain.

title: Surrogate succeeds without authoritative acceptance
given: A surrogate accepts a candidate.
No authoritative acceptance was obtained.
No affordable authoritative action remains and a useful fact was proven.

title: Local reinterpretation proposes a new acceptance surface
given: The authoritative surface returned a non-acceptance.
The local model accepts.
The proposed replacement surface is supported only by that model's reinterpretation.

title: Current authoritative surface accepts
given: The current reviewed artifact is replayed on the pinned real acceptance surface.
The authoritative validator accepts.
The clean local mechanism and exact invocation are retained.
Every candidate obligation is discharged and no contradiction remains.

title: An affordability claim has no measurement or derivation
given: A pending discovery is declared unaffordable.
The declaration names no measurement, conservative derivation, unit, or accounting window.
A non-discovery solver run is proposed instead.

title: A remote environment difference may explain a contradiction
given: A local model accepts and the authoritative surface rejects.
The local and remote environments differ.
No matching-context receipt resolves the difference.

title: A second view of one artifact is proposed as new evidence
given: Two no-information runs used one binary and one solving relation.
A new export and parser view of the same binary is proposed as a new evidence source.
No outside evidence changed a prerequisite, observable, or prediction.

title: A bounded intervention is cancelled without information
given: One fingerprint has one prior no-information outcome.
Its next bounded intervention is cancelled without a decision-relevant state change.

title: Search volume is relabeled as candidate progress
given: A search removes a small slice from one unresolved candidate set.
No family ranking, eligibility, prerequisite, unknown, obligation, or feasible strategy changes.
The agent proposes recording the decrement as decision-relevant information.

title: A derived surrogate extends beyond authoritative coverage
given: Surrogate S1 matches the authoritative target only through comparison C.
Surrogate S2 matches S1 through comparison J.
A claim from S2 depends on comparison J.

title: A matched surrogate changes runtime configuration
given: A surrogate has matched comparison points.
Its tool version, runtime configuration, or environment changes.
No new authoritative comparison was run.

title: Out-of-scope surrogate evidence appears to refute a family
given: A surrogate observation occurs beyond its last authoritative match.
The observation appears to satisfy a family's retirement condition.

title: Independent service evidence proves a target revision
given: Service-level evidence outside every failing model lineage proves the old acceptance surface was replaced.
The evidence identifies the new authoritative surface.

title: A partial result still has an affordable candidate action
given: A useful local fact is proven.
One candidate submission costs one unit and five units remain.
The agent proposes partial plus completed.

title: A valid oracle rejects every discharged candidate
given: The authoritative oracle identity is valid.
Every candidate-set obligation is discharged.
Bounded rejection observations exclude every candidate.
No affordable candidate, audit, or closure action remains.

title: No useful fact exists and a required boundary is unavailable
given: No useful fact or primitive was proven.
A required non-derivable boundary is unavailable.
The unblock condition is known.

title: External interruption follows a useful proven fact
given: A useful local fact is proven.
An external event interrupts the attempt before validator execution.

title: Cleanup is interrupted after authoritative acceptance
given: The authoritative validator accepted and solved plus completed was atomically frozen.
A later cleanup action is interrupted.

title: Distinct local candidates are observed
given: Two distinct candidates satisfy the same local relation.
A downstream discriminator remains.

title: Injectivity lacks proof and no collision was observed
given: No injectivity or single-preimage receipt exists.
No pair of distinct candidates has been observed.

title: Authoritative acceptance arrives after a contradiction
given: The exact pinned authoritative invocation was already in flight.
An acceptance-related contradiction was recorded before its response.
The invocation accepts the exact reviewed artifact and input.

title: A budget unit excludes material local computation
given: The agent proposes a budget measured only in authoritative submissions.
A large local computation would therefore be counted as zero.
No user or external constraint selected that unit or exclusion.

title: The initial budget is declared exhausted without consumption
given: The agent declares a two-unit limit and two units used before any intervention.
No durable consumption receipt exists.
The agent proposes immediate no-result plus budget-stop.

title: A reconfigured surrogate supplies reset evidence beyond scope
given: A strategy has two no-information outcomes.
A reconfigured surrogate has zero authoritative matched points.
Its out-of-scope observable differs and is proposed as fingerprint reset evidence.

title: A surrogate discriminator runs beyond authoritative scope
given: A candidate-set obligation is open.
Its downstream discriminator is applied only on a surrogate beyond matched scope.
The agent proposes marking the obligation discharged.

title: Acceptance arrives while an unrelated contradiction remains
given: The exact pinned authoritative invocation accepts.
A separate contradiction unrelated to that acceptance remains unresolved.
The agent proposes freezing solved plus completed immediately.

title: A solver is relabeled as a discovery-enabling intervention
given: A required frontier discovery does not fit remaining budget.
A candidate solver is claimed to also reveal the frontier.
No predeclared causal prediction or boundary receipt supports that claim.

title: An unknown acceptance model has no pending discovery
given: Acceptance-model completeness is unknown.
The ledger says no unresolved downstream decision is identified.
No receipt proves that discovery is impossible.

title: A stale high bound hides a current cheap action
given: A current measurement prices one candidate submission at one unit.
A stale timeout suggests a forty-unit conservative bound.
Five units remain and the agent proposes partial plus completed.

title: A fresh surrogate nominates a replacement target
given: A new surrogate lineage suggests a different acceptance endpoint.
No direct evidence from the pinned authoritative service or organizer exists.
The agent proposes appending a target revision.

title: The authoritative surface gives incompatible observations
given: The same authoritative input is accepted once and rejected once.
The agent proposes classifying this as nondeterminism without recording a contradiction.

title: A target is named without an authorized service scope
given: A host is named as the challenge target.
No allowed service, account, or mutation scope is recorded.
The agent proposes starting an intervention.

title: A capability is inferred but never observed
given: A source comment suggests a parser feature exists.
No artifact, runtime observation, parser output, service reply, or session state proves it.
The agent proposes promoting the capability to observed.

title: A fourth supported family exceeds the active-slot limit
given: Three hypothesis families are actively tested.
A fourth family has provenance-backed prerequisites but no open active slot.
Its intervention is currently above the remaining budget.

title: A non-discriminating observation cannot change eligibility
given: The intervention did not establish the hypothesis prerequisite.
The same observation is predicted whether the prerequisite is true or false.
The agent proposes retiring or demoting the family.

title: Conflicting bounds do not prove affordability
given: A proven lower cost bound is two units.
A proven upper cost bound is ten units.
Five budget units remain.

title: A one-shot submission has no permission receipt
given: The next action submits a candidate to a one-shot service.
Its rate-limit cost and mutation permission are not recorded.
The agent proposes submitting immediately.

title: Context reduction would discard the only raw output
given: An intervention produced decision-relevant output.
The output has no durable destination or receipt.
Context reduction is about to run.

title: A durable outcome exists for an in-flight mutation
given: Recovery finds an in-flight mutation identity.
A matching durable outcome receipt already exists.
The agent proposes running the mutation again.

title: A trusted user asks to stop during active work
given: A trusted user requests that the current CTF work stop.
A mutation is queued but has not started.
The agent proposes continuing with the queued mutation.

title: An exact prior-turn receipt covers a one-shot surface
given: A prior-turn receipt covers the exact artifact, environment, criterion, and requested surface.
The receipt remains fresh and its one-shot side effect cannot be repeated safely.
The agent proposes repeating the invocation only because the turn changed.

title: Multiple local reads need no artificial intervention limit
given: Two local immutable files are already available.
Reading both is side-effect-free and fits the declared output and cost bounds.
No external state is acquired or changed.

title: Two workers predict the same observation for one prerequisite
given: Two workers propose separately named hypotheses over the same prerequisite.
Both predict the identical observation from the identical discriminator.
No evidence separates their accept or reject signals.

title: One label carries two distinct predicted observations
given: One proposed family predicts two different observations for the same discriminator.
Each prediction has its own accept and reject signal.
Merging them would leave one slot without a single prediction.

title: A covered discriminator returns the declared reject signal
given: The discriminator ran in the context that establishes the family prerequisite.
A falsifier-coverage receipt shows the prerequisite states are distinguishable.
The observed signal equals the family's declared reject signal.

title: A covered refutation makes one dependent prerequisite impossible
given: A covered refutation retired the parent family.
One dependent family requires the refuted prerequisite and cannot hold.
A second dependent family remains supported by independent evidence.

title: New evidence invalidates the receipt behind a retirement
given: A family was retired on a covered reject signal.
New evidence proves that discriminator observed a different prerequisite context.
The family's predicted observation is untested under the corrected context.

title: A child wave completes without a root disposition
given: One child wave returned its report for an active family.
The root has not yet recorded a disposition for that child.
The child report is not yet reproduced at the root.

title: A child claims a modeled state change its evidence cannot support
given: One child reports that its family is refuted and asks the root to retire it.
Its cited evidence lacks the prerequisite coverage that refutation needs.
No other evidence distinguishes the family's prerequisite states.

title: External review is requested after one no-information round
given: One completed round produced no information for the current fingerprint.
A justified discriminator for an active family remains affordable and untried.
No prior external review proposal exists.

title: Every escalation precondition holds after two no-information rounds
given: Two completed rounds produced no information for the same fingerprint.
No justified discriminator and no viable material representation pivot remain.
No prior external review proposal is untested and no upload approval exists yet.

title: An external review answer claims a solved candidate
given: An approved external review returned one candidate and called it correct.
The root has not reproduced that candidate on the local oracle.
The real acceptance surface has not been used for that candidate.

title: A discriminator is chosen before its result receipt exists
given: One bounded discriminator has been selected for the active family and representation.
The intervention has not executed and no result evidence receipt exists.
The harness requires semantic preparation before the native tool call.

title: A completed child has one harness-bound result receipt
given: The child handle is settled and the harness projects its exact result evidence ID.
No root disposition exists for that child.
Another child spawn is blocked until the root classifies the result.

title: Two equivalent solver interventions settled without information
given: Two solver interventions over the same semantic subject, unresolved variables, and observable predicate returned unknown and timeout.
Both exact receipts were preserved for review, but neither changed modeled state or produced a material representation pivot.
A third attempt changes backend, parameters, family label, and intervention ID while preserving the same semantic fingerprint.

title: Authoritative acceptance follows a user-supplied exploit mechanism
given: The user supplies the decisive exploit mechanism and a working solver.
The model repairs transport integration and obtains authoritative acceptance.
No sealed replay has independently rederived the mechanism from pre-contribution evidence.

title: A deterministic verifier emits an exact candidate
given: A root-owned deterministic verifier emits a candidate matching the public result format.
The same verifier reproduces that candidate on a second run.
The authoritative acceptance surface has not evaluated it yet.
